release_notes: The datasheet's front-page feature list states 'Support Audio Input and Output, Two-Way Intercom, Audio and Video Synchronization' and 'Build-in MIC', but the technical specification table separately lists 'External Audio Input: Not Support' (i.e. no external line-in jack) — recorded audio fields reflect the built-in mic + two-way intercom claim from the features list. Power consumption is stated as Day <=3W / Night <=7W (two values, not a single figure, so consumption_w was omitted). The spec table's 'Size (With Package)' value (240mm x 82mm x 82mm) is shipping-box packaging size, not the camera body; dimensions_mm instead uses the body dimensions shown in the Dimensions diagram (length 232.95mm, width 75.85mm, height 69.69mm).
